propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack multi-page test coverage despite using opaque cursor pagination with nextPageToken and isLast termination conditions
The same defect class (truncated single-page reads) was fixed three times on DC/shared side (change 1105, rebar:9263, rebar:deac) but Cloud's copies have never been tested past page one

A repeated cursor token can cause the readers to spin forever when the server returns an identical non-null nextPageToken with isLast falsy, and fail-open exception handling converts this into a silently partial map

Regression test suite with 250-item seeded set across three pages must assert set recovery, cursor advancement via request bodies, independent termination conditions (isLast and exhausted token), and structural AST guard preventing future unpaginated whole-project readers
